findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the interior of the ice machine in the kitchen to be soiled with mold. PIC was informed and plans to remove all ice from the machine, deep clean, and sanitize. A follow-up is scheduled for May 16th to ensure the ice machine has been cleaned. Ensure staff are cleaning the ice machine frequently to prevent accumulation of soil.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment:
Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods to be held beyond 7 days past their date mark:
1. Fries (4/15)
2. Wings (4/29)
3. Nuggets (4/4)
4. Meatballs (4/1)
5. Sausage (4/20)
6. Blue Cheese dressing (3/17)
7. Ranch (4/25)

PIC was informed that these items were kept too long, and the items were discarded. Ensure food items are discarded after 7 days from the posted date mark.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior of ice machine in kitchen to be soiled with debris. Clean and sanitize interior of kitchen ice machine.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Observed cooking utensils on shelf above pizza prep cooler to be stored in a container that is soiled with food debris. Clean and sanitize container used to store cooking utensils. 

4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution available for use during food preparation. Sanitizing solution was made during inspection, and tested at 200 ppm quaternary ammonia.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. 
(B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed wood support boards under surface holding soda fountains to be warped and corroding. Replace wood support boards so that they are smooth and easily cleanable. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.
